instructions: Always use 'bun' instead of 'npm' or 'yarn' for package installation and scripts.
This project uses Tailwind CSS v4, React, TypeScript, Express, Socket.IO, and Leaflet maps.
When modifying maps, always use free tile providers without restricted API keys (such as Esri Dark Canvas or CartoDB Voyager).
Never commit sensitive credentials; always reference .env or .env.example.
